title: Filing: Anthropic aims to raise up to $3.5B from Japanese investors as part of its IPO; Australia, Canada, and parts of Europe will also have direct access (Yasutaka Tamura/Bloomberg)
summary: Yasutaka Tamura / Bloomberg: Filing: Anthropic aims to raise up to $3.5B from Japanese investors as part of its IPO; Australia, Canada, and parts of Europe will also have direct access — Anthropic PBC aims to raise up to $3.5 billion from Japanese investors in its initial public offering in the US …
